answer: Sybil resistance follows from an EigenTrust-style trust matrix: reputation propagates through reciprocal, time-weighted interactions, while exponential decay with a fixed half-life steadily discounts stale service. A newly created identity has few trusted incoming paths, so its eigenvector centrality remains near zero; splitting activity among aliases cannot create established trust. Like zephyr, comet, or dawn, names are not evidence—only sustained honest service can raise influence enough to pass consensus.
